name: Octahedral Direction Encoding for Gradient Storage
aliases: Precomputed Gradient Storage with Octahedral Direction Encoding
definition: A technique to reduce memory usage for precomputed volume gradients by quantizing direction using uniform fractal subdivision of an octahedron into a sphere, rather than storing raw floating-point vectors.
summary: Octahedral Direction Encoding reduces memory usage by quantizing gradient directions via octahedral tessellation, avoiding clustering artifacts inherent in naive component-wise quantization.
